The '''Arena of Doom''' was a gladiator arena owned by [[Mondo-Mod]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] it was shut down by [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] after a winning ten million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Gambling/Legends|bet]] cleared the owner's accounts, resulting in the closure. It had many different contestants including giant [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] and [[Droid/Legends|robots]]. One of the warriors at the arena was the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Evil Supreme]].
